findings.evidence: `rg -n "indVirtualCharacterSetCyclic"` finds only the definition and its use in the closure, while Spanning.lean:130 and :256 provide the two parallel `Iff.rfl` membership lemmas without automation annotations.
findings.fix: Add a `@[simp] theorem mem_indVirtualCharacterSetCyclic` stating the defining existential, and mark `mem_indSet` and `mem_indCharacterSet` `@[simp]` so membership reduces to the documented normal form.
findings.issue: `indVirtualCharacterSetCyclic` has no `mem_indVirtualCharacterSetCyclic` iff lemma, unlike the parallel `indSet` and `indCharacterSet`; consumers must unfold the definition to access its witnesses. The existing parallel membership lemmas at Spanning.lean:130 and :256 also lack `@[simp]`.

summary: The generating-set API is incomplete and its membership normal forms are unavailable to simplification.
